messages:
jamie: Cut scheduled in ~40m. I have 3 PRs blocking the cut: #4472, #4480, #4487. Need reviews and changelog headers. Backports required for #4472 and #4487 to release-1.x. Can someone grab reviews/backports?

jamie: Quick cherry-pick snippet if helpful:
```
git checkout release-1.x
git fetch origin
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
git push origin release-1.x
```
(Use -x to keep original refs.)

leah: :eyes: grabbing #4472 now, running unit tests locally.

ben: I'll take #4480. Looks like just a changelog header missing + small test tweak.

sofia: I can handle backports after merges. For #4487, is changelog `Bug Fixes` or `Performance`?

jamie: Bug Fixes for #4487.

jamie: @release-bot can you remind people about the `Unreleased` section on merge? Last cut had lint rejects.

release-bot: release-bot: Reminder scheduled — enforce `## Unreleased` top-level heading for changelog entries on merge.

ben: pushing a tiny commit to add the missing header to #4480.

ci-bot: ci-bot: build passed for PR #4480 — checks green. :white_check_mark:

leah: merged #4472 into main. Opened backport PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4499 — tagging @sofia for review.

sofia: reviewing backport PR 4499, left a nit about a fixture path. Will approve after update.

sofia: approved and merged backport 4499 — CI is green. :ship: 

alex: doing final review on #4487, will approve if no regressions by :20.

ben: confirmed changelog line: "fix(cli): handle empty flag list" placed under `## Unreleased\n### Bug Fixes`.

ci-bot: ci-bot: all checks passed for #4487.

alex: approved #4487, left one non-blocking logging nit.

jamie: awesome — thanks all. Reminder: if the cut smoke tests fail, HOLD any merges and ping #eng-sre immediately. I'll monitor the cut and open a rollforward if needed. :rocket:
